description: Do licences, certificates or insurance policies cover a required period without gaps? — Given a required date range (a contract term, a project, a shipment window) and up to 200 credentials each valid from a date to a date (both inclusive), reports the merged covered ranges, every uncovered gap with its first and last day and length, and whether each checkpoint date is covered; a credential ending the day before the next starts is contiguous. checkpoints.description: Specific dates that must be covered (delivery date, audit date).

toleratedGapDays.description: Gaps up to this many days are reported but do not fail (a grace period you are entitled to).
